name: loomwright-lanes
description: Optional live pane for Loomwright's /automate --parallel lanes: /lanes shows every lane (its current step on a seven-step rail, start time, state, PR, branch, readiness, machine load and keep-awake) and answers a waiting lane's question with one button per option. Reads and writes only through Loomwright's lane-status / lane-feed / lane-answer; uninstalling it changes nothing about a run.

loomwrightRoot.title: Loomwright plugin folder
loomwrightRoot.description: The folder holding Loomwright's scripts/ (a dev checkout's loomwright/, say). Empty uses the installed loomwright plugin that `claude plugin list` reports.
